evaluate.expression: (async () => { const listIds = async () => { try { const res = await fetch('/vrooli.web_console.v1.sessions.SessionsService/List', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}', cache: 'no-store' }); if (!res.ok) return null; const body = await res.json(); const rows = Array.isArray(body) ? body : (body && body.sessions) || []; return rows.map((s) => s && s.id).filter(Boolean); } catch { return null; } }; const readBaseline = () => { try { const raw = sessionStorage.getItem('__bas_baseline_sessions'); if (!raw) return null; const parsed = JSON.parse(raw); return Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed : null; } catch { return null; } }; const baseline = new Set(readBaseline() || []); const deadline = Date.now() + 10000; let target = ''; while (Date.now() < deadline) { const ids = await listIds();  if (ids) { const fresh = ids.filter((id) => !baseline.has(id));   if (fresh.length > 0) { target = fresh[fresh.length - 1]; break; } }  await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 150)); } window.__bas_target_session = target; document.body.setAttribute('data-bas-target-session', target); document.body.setAttribute('data-bas-target-resolved', target ? 'true' : 'false'); })()
